LightningComponentBundle.description: Adds one event to Google Calendar, Outlook, Yahoo Calendar, Apple Calendar, or a downloaded calendar file. Pass event details from any Salesforce record. Start and End come from Date/Time fields, or are written as UTC.

property.name: eventTitle
property.label: Title
property.description: Calendar title. Blank uses Event.

property.name: startDateTime
property.label: Start
property.description: Required. Event start. The button stays disabled when this is blank.

property.name: endDateTime
property.label: End
property.description: Event end. Blank means one hour after start. For an all-day event this is the last day, and a blank end means that day only.

property.name: allDay
property.label: All Day
property.description: When true, the event uses calendar dates instead of times.

property.name: timeZone
property.label: Time Zone
property.description: Named time zone such as America/Los_Angeles. Used for all-day dates and Google Calendar. Timed events are written in UTC.

property.name: eventUrl
property.label: URL
property.description: Meeting or other URL stored on the calendar event and added to the web calendar description.

property.name: eventUid
property.label: Event UID
property.description: Stable calendar id. Pass the Event UID from Send Email with Calendar Event so the downloaded file refers to the same event. A new id is created when blank.

property.name: buttonVariant
property.label: Button Style
property.description: Type one of: neutral, brand, brand-outline, destructive, destructive-text, success, inverse, base. Blank uses neutral.

property.name: showApple
property.label: Show Apple Calendar
property.description: Opens the calendar file. Calendar on a Mac or iPhone offers to add the event.

property.name: debug
property.label: Debug
property.description: When true, writes the inputs and calendar result to the browser console. Errors are logged even when this is false.

property.name: selectedCalendar
property.label: Selected Calendar
property.description: The menu item that was clicked: google, outlook, outlookLive, yahoo, apple, or ics. Blank when nothing was clicked.

property.name: eventTitle
property.label: Title
property.description: Calendar title. Blank uses Event.

property.name: startDateTime
property.label: Start
property.description: Required. UTC date-time, such as 2026-09-29T17:00:00.000Z. App Builder has no date picker for this field. Experience Builder does.

property.name: endDateTime
property.label: End
property.description: UTC date-time, same form as Start. Blank means one hour after start, or that day only when All Day is checked.

property.name: allDay
property.label: All Day
property.description: When true, the event uses calendar dates instead of times.

property.name: timeZone
property.label: Time Zone
property.description: Used for all-day dates and Google Calendar. Leave blank to use UTC for all-day dates.

property.name: buttonVariant
property.label: Button Style
property.description: SLDS button style. Neutral is a plain button. Brand is the blue primary button.

property.name: debug
property.label: Debug
property.description: When true, writes the inputs and calendar result to the browser console.

property.name: startDateTime
property.label: Start
property.description: Required. Pick the date and time in your time. The page stores it in UTC.

property.name: endDateTime
property.label: End
property.description: Pick the end. Leave blank for one hour after start, or that day only when All Day is checked.

property.name: timeZone
property.label: Time Zone
property.description: Used for all-day dates and Google Calendar. Leave blank to use UTC for all-day dates.

property.name: buttonVariant
property.label: Button Style
property.description: SLDS button style. Neutral is a plain button. Brand is the blue primary button.
